project.description: The name of the project to make publishable (e.g., 'lib-my-utils')

globalName.description: Global variable name for IIFE/UMD builds (e.g., 'HyperfrontendMyUtils')

bundleEntry.description: Entry point for IIFE/UMD bundles (e.g., '.' or './browser')

keywords.x-prompt: Enter npm keywords for this package (comma-separated)

compatibility.description: Runtime profile written to metadata.compatibility in project.json: 'isomorphic' runs in Node, browsers and Web Workers, 'node-only' runs in Node alone, 'browser-only' runs in browsers and Web Workers. A package with partial support in a runtime declares it by hand instead.

docsCategory.description: Section of the docs-site library index the package is listed under. Defaults to 'utils' for a package under libs/utils, 'core' for a project tagged type:core, and 'supporting' otherwise.

ecosystemTier.description: Level of the docs-site ecosystem hierarchy the package is appended to, which also fixes its place in the root README's packages table. Defaults to 'utilities' for a package listed under utils and 'standalone' otherwise.
